about.title:
Imyaka Mirongo Itandatu
y'Ukwizera n'Imirimo
about.p1: Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda (CPR) yashinzwe mu 1963, ni umuzimwa uhuza amatorero 19 y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda. Kuva yashingwa, CPR yagize uruhare rukomeye mu mibereho y'abaturage — kubaka imiryango nyuma y'amakimbirane, guteza imbere uburezi, no kubumbatira agaciro ka buri muntu.
about.p2Start: Uyu munsi, binyuze mu mashami yayo y'uburezi, ubuzima, ivugabutumwa, n'itumanaho, CPR igera mu ntara zose z'u Rwanda. Intego yacu —

departments.title: Amashami n'Imishinga
departments.desc: Ibikorwa bya CPR bikorwa binyuze mu mashami ane akomeye, buri shami rifite uruhare mu mpinduka z'u Rwanda.

items.title: Ubunyamabanga Bukuru

items.desc: Yita ku gushaka ubushobozi bw'ikigo, imicungire inoze y'imari, no gushaka umutungo.

items.title: Gahunda y'Urubyiruko
items.desc: Ifasha urubyiruko binyuze mu kubaka amahoro, ubwiyunge, no kubaha amahugurwa y'ubuyobozi.

items.desc: Iteza imbere uburinganire, irwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, n'iterambere ry'abagore.

items.quote: Buruse ya CPR yahinduye ubuzima bwanjye. Ubu ndi muganga ufasha abaturage.
Radio Inkoramutima igera mu mudugudu wacu buri gitondo. Ibiganiro byayo byadufashije kubona amahoro.
Binyuze mu mahugurwa ya BNEP, abarimu bacu ubu barigisha neza. Imitsindire yazamutseho 40%.

whoWeAre.title: Kuri Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda
whoWeAre.p1: Inama y'Abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda (CPR) yashinzwe mu 1963 ngo iteze imbere kandi isangize abantu ibikorwa bishya z'iterambere n'oserivisi z'ingenzi mu matorero yacu n'abaturage bose.
whoWeAre.p2: Twiyemeje kubaka ubufatanye bukomeye no gutanga serivisi zo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu gushyigikira ukwizera, ubumwe, n'iterambere rirambye mu Rwanda hose.

visionMission.title: Icyerekezo n'Inshingano
visionMission.visionDesc: Umuryango w'abanyarwanda wunze ubumwe, wizerwa, kandi uteye imbere aho buri muntu aba mu cyubahiro n'amahoro.
visionMission.missionDesc: Guhuza amatorero y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda ngo tugire uruhare rugaragara mu ivugabutumwa, uburezi, ubuzima, n'iterambere rusange w'imibereho n'ubukungu.

model.title: Uburyo Twukora
model.desc: Uburyo bwo guhuza ubufatanye bhuza amatorero n'amatsinda ku ntego zo gufasha abaturage.
model.step1Desc: Amatorero y'abaporotesitanti mu Rwanda yunze ubumwe mu murongo umwe.
model.step2Desc: Umutungo n'ubushobozi bokusanyirizwa mu misanzu y'imbere mu gihugu n'ubufatanye mpuzamahanga.
model.step3Desc: Imishinga irambye yibanda ku baturage ishyirwa mu bikorwa mu nzego zose.

items.title: Ukwizera
items.desc: Shingiye ku nyigisho zacu za gikristu, ukwizera kuyobora ibikorwa n'ibyemezo byacu byose.

items.title: Ubumwe
items.desc: Guhuza amatorero atandukanye ngo avuge kandi akore mu ijwi rimwe.

items.title: Inyangamugayo
items.desc: Gushyigikira mucungire yera n'ubwiyunge mu ibikorwa byacu byose.

items.title: Ubwisungane / Serivisi
items.desc: Wiyemeje gukorera abafite intege nke mu mbabazi n'urukundo.

items.title: Ubunyangamugayo / Ireme
items.desc: Guharanira ireme ryo ku rwego rwo hejuru mu uburezi, ubuzima, n'imishinga y'iterambere.

execCommittee.title: Komite Nyobozi
execCommittee.desc: Ikipe yacu y'abanyamwuga n'abayobozi b'amatorero izana ubushobozi butandukanye gushyigikira inshingano z a CPR.
